fusions.name: Fruiting Javelin
fusions.desc: Hurls a fruiting body at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 32 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Lunging Hyphae
fusions.desc: You rush the target and drive in a hypha that deals 13 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Far Fruiting
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. You regain 12 health.

fusions.name: Barbed Aftermath
fusions.desc: When you land a strike, a spore bolt hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 5 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
